title: Roshan contextual voice audit and line ledger
scope: Read-only audit of playable actions, locations, transitions, and narrative beats that currently speak through the non-Faron voice pipeline. The rows identify generic or repeated Roshan cues and propose a situation-specific replacement.

speaker.name: Roshan
speaker.delivery: bright, small, curious, simple vocabulary, one thought per breath; excited but never adult or commanding

implementation_notes: This is an audit/authoring ledger only. Runtime bindings, TTS generation, and protected audio files are intentionally unchanged.
Keep each proposed event unique to its trigger; do not route every row back to talk, win, pearl, or idle2.
A proposed event key is a recording brief, not evidence that an audio file exists. Generate/listen/test each clip before wiring it.
Prefer one contextual line on entry or completion and a cooldown on repeated proximity/tap events. Re-triggering the same action should rotate within its own small set.
Rows marked P0 are the first pass: they are highly visible, currently generic/repeated, or directly answer the requested castle-dusty example.
